description: Find existing bugs similar to a component, page, or description via pgvector nearest-neighbour search (same backend as search_reports, tuned for "have we seen this before?"). Returns ranked { reports: [{ id, summary, similarity }] }. Read-only. Use to dedupe before filing or group regressions; use search_reports for general free-text search.

query.description: Component name, page path, or bug description

name: get_similar_bugs
title: Similar bugs
